name: linux-kernel-analysis
description: Source-grounded workflows for analyzing mainline Linux kernel code and authoring validated Markdown learning books.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze kernel source and author Markdown books.
interface.longDescription: A family of source-grounded workflows for static analysis of mainline Linux kernel boundary contracts, object lifetimes, state and path selection, execution-context handoffs, concurrency, resource flow, failure recovery, and performance mechanisms, plus authoring validated Markdown learning books with a global README, source companion, labs, and complete solutions.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this mainline Linux kernel subsystem from source.
Trace the source-defined execution-context handoffs in this mainline driver.
Derive the boundary contracts of this mainline kernel component.
Turn this source analysis into a validated Markdown kernel learning book.
